title: Best VTuber Avatar Creators (2026): 2D and 3D Streaming Avatars
h1: Best Virtual and Streaming Avatar Creators
description: How to hire a VTuber or virtual avatar creator for 2D or 3D streaming avatars: art, rigging, tracking, rights, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Virtual avatar creators design and build characters you control on stream or in videos, often called VTubers. Projects include 2D illustrated avatars rigged for face tracking and full 3D models. A good avatar is expressive, matches your personality and works smoothly with your tracking software. Projects go wrong when art and rigging are done by people who do not coordinate, files do not work in your software, or rights for the character are unclear. This guide helps you get an avatar ready to go live.

faq.a: 2D avatars are drawn and rigged for movement; 3D avatars allow full-body movement and different camera angles. Choose based on your content and budget.

faq.q: Do I need separate artists for art and rigging?
faq.a: Often yes. Some creators do both. Make sure files are prepared in layers for rigging.

faq.q: Which software will it work with?
faq.a: Tell the creator your tracking software so the model is exported correctly.
Agree in writing on ownership, commercial use and whether the artist can show the character in their portfolio.
Avatars often take weeks. Plan your debut date with buffer.
